title: X OAuth 1.0a access token secret in an oauth_token_secret field
summary: A synthetic access token secret after oauth_token_secret in a form-encoded body next to oauth_token, in a JSON object and in a shell assignment.
rationale: X documents the access token secret as the oauth_token_secret issued together with the OAuth 1.0a user access token in the 3-legged flow. The documentation states no prefix, alphabet or width, so the field name is the only identifying context and no bare-value rule is implied. The secret is the secret half only: oauth_token and oauth_signature next to it are not the secret, and the OAuth 2.0 client id and secret are different credentials. In a form body the extent stops at the next delimiter.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: the value of an oauth_token_secret parameter or field is treated as a credential. X documents the token secret and its field name (carrier existence only); the value admission and extent are the project's decisions.
